name: Qatar Islamic Insurance Group Q.P.S.C.
summary: Qatar Islamic Insurance Group Q.P.S.C. provides a range of insurance products and services in Qatar. It operates through three segments: Underwriting, Investments, and Real Estate. The company offers personal insurance products comprising motor, medical, travel, maid, home, life, and yacht and boat insurance. It also provides corporate insurance products, such as energy, engineering, general accident, corporate liability, fire and property, marine cargo, marine hull, motor fleet, group medical, and group life insurance; and takaful insurance products.
